name: cobol-cobc-budget-timing-limits
body: cobc_agreement_and_performance_budget times one cobc batch against the best of three release cobolfrontend runs by wall clock on the machine running it, and detects COPY-using programs by a plain COPY word match on non-comment lines. Limits: the ratio can flake on a loaded machine, and a COPY word inside a string literal counts as a COPY program. Upgrade by averaging several cobc runs or widening the bound if the budget check flakes, and by a token-level COPY check if a string-literal false positive ever appears.
